INSERT INTO blackjacks (
                dealer,
                player,
                state,
                owner_id,
                staked,
                channel_id,
                message_id
            ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            RETURNING
                id,
                dealer,
                player,
                state as "state: BlackjackState",
                channel_id,
                message_id,
                owner_id,
                staked as "staked: Currency"
